subject: Re: Demo scheduling - Redwood Inference intro & qualification
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@carewell.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in a demo - CareWell use case

Hi Marissa,

We just completed a self-serve signup and I wanted to follow up to get a short demo scheduled. We're evaluating Redwood to reduce inference cost for a clinical summarization feature in our provider portal. A few quick notes: 
- Use case: on-demand clinical note summarization and structured extraction for providers (FHIR outputs).
- Volume: starting ~50k requests/month, expected to scale to 250k in 6-9 months.
- Timeline: decision within Q1; pilot in December would be ideal.

Can we book a 30 min intro/demo and cover architecture/PII handling? I'll loop in our engineering lead if useful.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Product, CareWell Health
S: (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@carewell.io>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo - CareWell use case

Hi Samantha - great to meet you and thanks for the details. Happy to get a short demo on the calendar this week or next. Before we lock time, two quick qualification questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Data sensitivity & residency: will any PHI be sent to a hosted service, or would you be looking at Private deployment (VPC/on-prem)?
2) Peak concurrency / latency requirements: do you need sub-200ms p95 inference or are longer latencies acceptable for batch summarization?
3) Integration surface: will you call Redwood from a server-side service or client-side (browser/mobile)?
4) Success criteria & decision-makers: who needs to attend the demo and what are the top 2 success metrics for the pilot?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Tue 12/1 10:00-10:30am
- Wed 12/2 9:00-9:30am
- Thu 12/3 1:00-1:30pm

If none of those work, here’s my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

I attached a one-pager with product highlights.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0112
Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@carewell.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo - CareWell use case

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the quick reply. Answering your questions inline: 
1) PHI: yes, notes will include PHI. For the pilot we'd prefer a hosted private VPC if possible, otherwise strict contractual protections + enterprise KMS.
2) Latency: for in-session provider workflows we'd like p95 < 300ms; for background processing we can tolerate higher.
3) Integration: server-side calls from our backend (EKS).
4) Decision-makers: myself (product), Ben Harris (engineering lead) and our Head of Security may join later. Success criteria: 1) accuracy of summaries vs internal baseline, 2) predictable cost per request, 3) audit logs + retention controls.

Best slots for us: Wed 12/2 09:00-09:30 PST or Thu 12/3 13:00-13:30 PST. Please include a technical advocate from Redwood. I attached a simple diagram of our flow.


Samantha Lee
Head of Product, CareWell Health
Attachment: carewell-arch.png
